svg.text: What ships today, what is built but switched off, and what the v3 reference and the C6 record change — as of 2026-08-12.
Brains Host — private network, GPU, never public
Sends the photo and the patient's own DINs
The DIN join happens once, at prescription time.
[Container: IMB1_v0 — FastSAM · colorimetric colour · shape CNN · imprint OCR]
Describes the pill. It never decides which medication it is.
ARRIVING: a two-stage reader — A3 (Qwen3-VL 8.8B, Ollama) says whether text is present at all;
A4c (Qwen3-VL 4B, transformers) ranks a closed lexicon built from this patient's own candidates.
[Container: sb2 package — no model, no retrieval, no network, no cloud key]
Real values on the 15 gold OTC DINs only.
Confusable pairs enter and leave together.

IMB1 and SB2, or the boundary fails loudly.

abstain action — never a bare yes/no.

when to ask for the other face.
IMB1 never says which side it photographed:
which side a face IS is the reference's

Colour is compared as a set; a mismatch
scores zero and never rejects alone.
Without an imprint the ceiling is 0.45
against an accept gate of 0.70 — appearance
alone can never verify, and v3 keeps it so.
LOGO is a reference value, not an OCR
failure: reading nothing off it matches.
ARRIVING: the dual i1+i3 fusion gives way
to one gated read. gated=true means NO
read — that flag IS the safety mechanism.
verify · reject · abstain → ask_to_flip or shortlist
Tuned to minimise false accepts; abstaining is the common case here, not an edge case.
the record — see the contract card, lower left
The IMB1 → SB2 record — what the C6 contract changes
faces[ ] — one entry per face actually photographed
face_id — opaque; never side1/side2, SB2 resolves the side
presence — TEXT | UNREADABLE | NONE, from the A3 gate and only there
read{ top1, margin, gated, threshold, lexicon_id }
imprint_reads{ i1, i3 } — diagnostic only, out of the input contract
contract_version: “C6” — so a consumer can refuse what it cannot read
Today match_pill RAISES on a C6 record rather than mis-score it. Step 7 turns this contract into a pipeline.
SB2 verifies; it does not identify
It only ever compares a pill against the patient's own medications.
Open-set identification across the formulary was measured, and rejected.
SB2 no longer re-derives the imprint — the reader does that. SB2
independently REFUSES; that refusal is what it contributes.
None of this is promoted yet
Production SB2/ is content-hash identical to the 2026-08-10 snapshot.
Promotion is a schema migration, not a file copy.
